Onion Smothered Steak
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 13, 2009 - 11:26pm

Ingredients




1 Round steak (enough for 4)
1/4 cup Flour
2 tablespoons Shortening
3 mediums Onions, sliced
1 tablespoon Vinegar
1 Clove garlic, minced
1 Bay leaf
1/4 teaspoon Crushed thyme
1 teaspoon Salt
1/8 teaspoon Black pepper
1 cup Water

Preparation

1 Trim meat. Combine flour, salt & pepper. Pound into meat. Cut meat into serving size pieces. Brown in shortening. Drain. Top with onions. Stir in water & remaining ingredients. Cover & simmer for 1 hour. Remove bay leaf.
